cores: Redline: three interlocked incandescent orange plasma cylinders in a chunky angular gunmetal and copper reactor cradle, cooling fins, braided cables, asymmetrical mechanical speed fins. Three barrel silhouette.
Twin: emerald dual crystal hearts in two silver armored prongs forming a broad split tuning fork, luminous green energy bridge between them, exposed intricate connectors, two mirrored power sources.
Prism: enormous violet diamond held by four wickedly elegant gold and titanium angular containment claws, floating internal crystalline fractures, bold four-pointed star silhouette.
Comet: brilliant yellow comet energy engine with two sweeping bronze crescent wings pointing back, narrow streamlined teardrop core, turbine recesses and intricate precision engineered machinery.
Lance: long azure crystal needle between parallel gunmetal accelerator rails, silver clamp teeth and blue capacitor cells; tall narrow spear silhouette, jewel-like tip.
Hourglass: rose pink temporal energy hourglass, two bulbous rose quartz chambers with fine shimmering energy grains and a narrow waist, armored platinum rings and curved side supports.

Lodestone: thick U-shaped celestial electromagnet, white cyan poles, dark titanium yoke with precision silver edging, tiny floating metal fragments ONLY inside the horseshoe, gorgeous electric conduction details.

Brood: three small violet jeweled metallic drone eggs connected around a central lavender power hub in a triangular nest, each egg visibly distinct armored pod with silver folded wings and little luminous optics.
Sun: beautiful golden sun reactor, amber liquid plasma orb with eight articulated gold mechanical rays, silver gears and layered jeweled crown; compact radial sun silhouette.
snakes: Cinder Maw head: terrifying predatory biomechanical space serpent skull, massive furnace-orange inner mouth, charred titanium jaws with swept hooked fangs, thick black overlapping chitin plates and copper heat scars. Compact menacing head, not a whole snake.

Thorn Cathedral head: terrifying biomechanical space serpent skull, poisonous emerald optics, enormous swept serrated thorn mandibles, dark olive layered armored chitin and silver hooked crown. Compact menacing head, not a whole snake.

Violet Widow head: terrifying biomechanical space serpent skull, four glowing violet eyes, black obsidian arachnid armor, long curved silver scythe jaws and elegant alien head crest. Compact menacing head, not a whole snake.

Abyss Crown head: terrifying biomechanical space serpent skull, icy cyan inner organs, heavy dark naval titanium chitin, broad crown of angular antenna horns, angler-like mouth with many silver fangs. Compact menacing head, not a whole snake.

One modular biomechanical space serpent body vertebra, no head: heavy overlapping dark graphite chitin plates, layered silver edges, interlocking mechanical tendons, a glowing white central spinal channel, two swept side spikes, dorsal armor scale over a visible black ball-joint at top and bottom. Segmented predatory alien machine with rich exquisite material detail. Keep it roughly square so consecutive sections can overlap into a connected snake.

aegis: Premium transparent top-down blue jeweled reactor core in ornate layered silver and gold containment machinery. Original working name Aegis; now Treasure.
